white rice.swap: brown rice, quinoa, or cauliflower rice
white rice.pcos_reason: High glycemic index causes rapid insulin spikes. Best consumed mid-day when activity is highest. Always pair with heavy protein/fiber.

potato.swap: sweet potato, pumpkin, or raw banana (kachha kela)
potato.pcos_reason: High starchy carb. Sweet potatoes have a lower GI, more fiber, and stabilize blood sugar better.

full-fat milk.swap: skimmed milk, almond milk, or coconut milk
full-fat milk.pcos_reason: Full-fat dairy contains hormones that can stimulate IGF-1, worsening PCOS acne and increasing androgen levels.

mutton.pcos_reason: Red meats promote inflammation which worsens PCOS. Lean meats or plant proteins are much safer.

paneer.pcos_reason: Excellent protein, but calorie-dense. Women with dairy-sensitive PCOS should monitor for acne breakouts.
